import ast
import hashlib
import json
import subprocess
from collections import Counter
from datetime import datetime
from pathlib import Path

ROOT = Path(__file__).resolve().parents[2]
OUT = Path(__file__).resolve().parent
LOCK = "src/image_downloader/storage/interprocess_lock.py"


def git(*args):
    return subprocess.check_output(["git", *args], cwd=ROOT).decode("utf-8")


def sha(data):
    return hashlib.sha256(data).hexdigest()


def make_inventory():
    commits = git("rev-list", "--all", "--reverse", "--topo-order").splitlines()
    records = []
    for commit in commits:
        source = git("show", f"{commit}:{LOCK}")
        tree = ast.parse(source)
        lock_class = next(node for node in tree.body if isinstance(node, ast.ClassDef)
                          and node.name == "InterProcessFileLock")
        records.append({"commit": commit,
                        "metadata": git("show", "-s", "--format=%cI%n%s%n%b%n%P", commit).strip(),
                        "changed_files": git("diff-tree", "--root", "--no-commit-id", "--name-only", "-r", commit).splitlines(),
                        "lock_blob": git("rev-parse", f"{commit}:{LOCK}").strip(),
                        "lock_sha256": sha(source.encode()),
                        "lock_class_ast_sha256": sha(ast.dump(lock_class, include_attributes=False).encode()),
                        "history_test_exists": subprocess.run(
                            ["git", "cat-file", "-e", f"{commit}:tests/v3/application/test_workflow_history.py"],
                            cwd=ROOT, capture_output=True).returncode == 0,
                        "source": source})
    status = git("status", "--porcelain")
    original_changes = {}
    for line in status.splitlines():
        path = line[3:]
        file = ROOT / path
        if file.is_file():
            original_changes[path] = sha(file.read_bytes())
    value = {"recorded_at": datetime.now().astimezone().isoformat(), "head": git("rev-parse", "HEAD").strip(),
             "refs": git("for-each-ref", "--format=%(refname) %(objectname)", "refs/heads", "refs/remotes", "refs/tags"),
             "is_shallow": git("rev-parse", "--is-shallow-repository").strip(),
             "roots": git("rev-list", "--all", "--max-parents=0").splitlines(),
             "commits": records, "status_before": status, "original_uncommitted_files": original_changes,
             "lock_blobs": dict(Counter(r["lock_blob"] for r in records)),
             "lock_class_ast": dict(Counter(r["lock_class_ast_sha256"] for r in records))}
    (OUT / "inventory.json").write_text(json.dumps(value, ensure_ascii=False, indent=2) + "\n", encoding="utf-8")
    print(json.dumps({k: value[k] for k in ("roots", "lock_blobs", "lock_class_ast")}, indent=2))
    return value


if __name__ == "__main__":
    make_inventory()

import ctypes
import hashlib
import importlib.metadata
import json
import os
import subprocess
import sys
import time
from datetime import datetime
from pathlib import Path

import psutil

ROOT = Path(__file__).resolve().parents[2]
OUT = Path(__file__).resolve().parent
REPO = OUT / "repository"
PROBE = ROOT / "docs/investigations/quality-security-review-2026-10-06/probes/history_lock_revision_probe.py"


def now():
    return datetime.now().astimezone().isoformat()


def write(path, value):
    path.write_text(json.dumps(value, ensure_ascii=False, indent=2) + "\n", encoding="utf-8")


def git(*args):
    return subprocess.check_output(["git", "-c", f"safe.directory={REPO.as_posix()}",
                                    "-C", str(REPO), *args]).decode("utf-8").strip()


def stop_owned(process):
    try:
        children = psutil.Process(process.pid).children(recursive=True)
    except psutil.NoSuchProcess:
        children = []
    for child in children:
        try:
            child.terminate()
        except psutil.NoSuchProcess:
            pass
    _, alive = psutil.wait_procs(children, timeout=5)
    for child in alive:
        try:
            child.kill()
        except psutil.NoSuchProcess:
            pass
    psutil.wait_procs(alive, timeout=5)
    if process.poll() is None:
        process.terminate()
    process.wait(10)


def execute(command, label, timeout, cwd=ROOT):
    execution = {"label": label, "command": command, "cwd": str(cwd), "started_at": now(), "timed_out": False}
    environment = os.environ.copy()
    environment["PYTHONDONTWRITEBYTECODE"] = "1"
    environment["PYTHONPATH"] = str(REPO / "src")
    start = time.monotonic()
    with (OUT / f"{label}.log").open("w", encoding="utf-8") as log:
        process = subprocess.Popen(command, cwd=cwd, env=environment, stdout=log, stderr=subprocess.STDOUT)
        try:
            process.wait(timeout)
        except subprocess.TimeoutExpired:
            execution["timed_out"] = True
            stop_owned(process)
        except BaseException:
            stop_owned(process)
            raise
    execution.update(exitcode=process.returncode, finished_at=now(), seconds=time.monotonic() - start)
    write(OUT / f"{label}-execution.json", execution)
    return execution


def snapshot(label):
    security = json.loads(subprocess.check_output(["powershell", "-NoProfile", "-Command",
                                                  (OUT / "environment.ps1").read_text(encoding="utf-8")],
                                                  encoding="utf-8-sig"))
    ctypes.windll.kernel32.GetModuleHandleW.argtypes = [ctypes.c_wchar_p]
    ctypes.windll.kernel32.GetModuleHandleW.restype = ctypes.c_void_p
    value = {"security": security, "python": sys.version, "executable": sys.executable,
             "guard64_loaded": bool(ctypes.windll.kernel32.GetModuleHandleW("guard64.dll")),
             "packages": {name: importlib.metadata.version(name) for name in
                          ("pytest", "pytest-cov", "pytest-asyncio", "pytest-mock", "httpx", "anyio", "ruff", "mypy", "psutil")}}
    write(OUT / f"environment-{label}.json", value)
    return value


def checkout(commit):
    if git("status", "--porcelain"):
        raise RuntimeError("isolated checkout must be clean before moving")
    git("checkout", "--quiet", "--detach", commit)
    assert git("rev-parse", "HEAD") == commit
    return hashlib.sha256((REPO / "src/image_downloader/storage/interprocess_lock.py").read_bytes()).hexdigest()


def main():
    inventory = json.loads((OUT / "inventory.json").read_text(encoding="utf-8"))
    evidence = {"started_at": now(), "environment_before": snapshot("before"), "checkouts": [], "integration": [],
                "probe_sha256": hashlib.sha256(PROBE.read_bytes()).hexdigest(),
                "isolation": "Local no-hardlinks clone, detached commits, original checkout preserved",
                "module_probe_scope": "Exact historical lock/exception modules; package initializers excluded",
                "startup_metadata_query": "Initial -File invocation rejected by execution policy before tests; read-only commands run via -Command; policy unchanged",
                "clone_ownership": "Clone created by CodexSandboxOffline; elevated runner uses pc01. Exact clone path is process-limited safe.directory; global settings unchanged",
                "rounds_per_commit": 30, "workers_per_commit": 3, "hold_seconds": 0.001}
    write(OUT / "evidence.json", evidence)
    for position, record in enumerate(inventory["commits"], 1):
        commit = record["commit"]
        source_hash = checkout(commit)
        label = f"commit-{position:02}-{commit[:7]}"
        result = execute([sys.executable, str(PROBE), str(REPO / "src"), str(OUT / label), "--rounds", "30"], label, 90)
        summary_path = OUT / label / "summary.json"
        observation = json.loads(summary_path.read_text(encoding="utf-8")) if summary_path.exists() else None
        if observation:
            assert all(w["module_sha256"] == source_hash for w in observation["workers"])
            assert all(Path(w["module"]).resolve() == (REPO / "src/image_downloader/storage/interprocess_lock.py").resolve()
                       for w in observation["workers"])
        row = {"commit": commit, "position": position, "lock_blob": record["lock_blob"],
               "working_source_sha256": source_hash, "execution": result, "observation": observation}
        evidence["checkouts"].append(row)
        write(OUT / "evidence.json", evidence)
        print(json.dumps({"position": position, "total": len(inventory["commits"]), "commit": commit[:7],
                          "complete": observation and observation["protocol_completed"],
                          "errors": observation and observation["errors"], "seconds": round(result["seconds"], 3)}), flush=True)
    checkpoints = ("21decb6", "40a93d1", "afd7581", "92a3d0c", "d7e6a1b", "c4ef652")
    for short in checkpoints:
        commit = git("rev-parse", short)
        checkout(commit)
        for repetition in range(1, 4):
            label = f"integration-{short}-{repetition}"
            result = execute([sys.executable, "-m", "pytest", "-q", "--no-cov", "-p", "no:cacheprovider",
                              "--basetemp", str(OUT / f"{label}-temporary"),
                              "tests/v3/application/test_workflow_history.py::test_independent_processes_merge_under_shared_history_lock"],
                             label, 100, cwd=REPO)
            log = (OUT / f"{label}.log").read_text(encoding="utf-8")
            row = {"commit": commit, "execution": result, "pytest_log": log,
                   "failure_kind": ("initialization_flush_PermissionError"
                                    if "in _ensure_lock_byte" in log and "PermissionError: [Errno 13]" in log
                                    else "other" if result["exitcode"] else None)}
            evidence["integration"].append(row)
            write(OUT / "evidence.json", evidence)
            print(json.dumps({"integration": label, "exitcode": result["exitcode"], "kind": row["failure_kind"]}), flush=True)
    evidence["environment_after"] = snapshot("after")
    evidence["finished_at"] = now()
    evidence["isolated_checkout_final_head"] = git("rev-parse", "HEAD")
    write(OUT / "evidence.json", evidence)
    print(json.dumps({"finished": True, "commits": len(evidence["checkouts"]), "integration": len(evidence["integration"])}), flush=True)


if __name__ == "__main__":
    main()

import ast
import csv
import hashlib
import json
import subprocess
from collections import Counter
from datetime import datetime
from pathlib import Path

ROOT = Path(__file__).resolve().parents[2]
OUT = Path(__file__).resolve().parent
DOCS = ROOT / "docs/investigations/quality-security-review-2026-10-06"
LOCK = "src/image_downloader/storage/interprocess_lock.py"


def read(path):
    return json.loads(path.read_text(encoding="utf-8"))


def sha(path):
    return hashlib.sha256(path.read_bytes()).hexdigest()


def git(*args):
    return subprocess.check_output(["git", *args], cwd=ROOT).decode("utf-8")


def main():
    inventory = read(OUT / "inventory.json")
    results = read(OUT / "evidence.json")
    assert "finished_at" in results and len(results["checkouts"]) == 52
    assert len(results["integration"]) == 18
    rechecks = read(OUT / "recheck-evidence.json")
    assert "finished_at" in rechecks and len(rechecks["observations"]) == 3
    assert all(x["observation"] and x["observation"]["protocol_completed"] for x in rechecks["observations"])
    assert results["environment_before"]["python"] == results["environment_after"]["python"]
    assert results["environment_before"]["packages"] == results["environment_after"]["packages"]
    assert git("rev-parse", "HEAD").strip() == inventory["head"]
    assert not git("diff", "HEAD", "--", "src", "tests", "pyproject.toml")
    for name, expected in inventory["original_uncommitted_files"].items():
        assert sha(ROOT / name) == expected
    rows = []
    errors = Counter()
    incomplete_artifacts = []
    for item, record in zip(results["checkouts"], inventory["commits"], strict=True):
        assert item["commit"] == record["commit"]
        observation = item["observation"]
        scope = "complete"
        if observation is None:
            scope = "surviving_worker_results_only"
            folder = OUT / item["execution"]["label"]
            workers = []
            files = []
            for path in sorted(folder.glob("worker-*.json")):
                text = path.read_text(encoding="utf-8")
                files.append({"name": path.name, "bytes": path.stat().st_size, "raw": text})
                if text:
                    workers.append(json.loads(text))
            partial_errors = Counter()
            for worker in workers:
                assert worker["module_sha256"] == item["working_source_sha256"]
                partial_errors.update(worker["errors"])
            observation = {"protocol_completed": False, "workers": workers,
                           "attempts_requested": 90, "successes": sum(w["successes"] for w in workers),
                           "errors": dict(partial_errors)}
            incomplete_artifacts.append({"commit": item["commit"], "files": files,
                                         "parent_log": (OUT / f"{item['execution']['label']}.log").read_text(encoding="utf-8"),
                                         "reconstructed_partial_summary": observation,
                                         "missing_worker_results": 3 - len(workers)})
        else:
            assert observation["protocol_completed"] and item["execution"]["exitcode"] == 0
            assert sum(w["rounds"] for w in observation["workers"]) == 90
        errors.update(observation["errors"])
        tree = ast.parse(record["source"])
        cls = next(n for n in tree.body if isinstance(n, ast.ClassDef) and n.name == "InterProcessFileLock")
        locations = {n.name: n.lineno for n in cls.body if isinstance(n, (ast.FunctionDef, ast.AsyncFunctionDef))}
        metadata = record["metadata"].splitlines()
        rows.append({"position": item["position"], "commit": item["commit"], "date": metadata[0],
                     "subject": metadata[1], "lock_blob": record["lock_blob"],
                     "lock_class_ast_sha256": record["lock_class_ast_sha256"],
                     "working_source_sha256": item["working_source_sha256"],
                     "attempts": observation["attempts_requested"], "flush_errors": observation["errors"].get("initialization_flush_PermissionError", 0),
                     "other_errors": observation["errors"].get("other", 0), "successes": observation["successes"],
                     "protocol_completed": observation["protocol_completed"], "seconds": item["execution"]["seconds"],
                     "statistics_scope": scope, "saved_attempts": sum(w["rounds"] for w in observation["workers"]),
                     "missing_worker_results": 3 - len(observation["workers"]),
                     "history_test_exists": record["history_test_exists"], "initializer_line": locations["_ensure_lock_byte"]})
    classification = {}
    suspects = {
        "18488a5": ("初期ロック実装", "排他前初期化・a+b open・open後deadlineが初回から存在"),
        "44e12c5": ("設定・移行", "設定と出力ロック周辺の変更。共通ロック本体に差分なし"),
        "72cc8ce": ("状態保存", "状態処理の変更。共通ロック本体に差分なし"),
        "f1a321b": ("workflow導入", "既存ロックを利用するworkflow保存・feedロックを追加"),
        "dc8e4af": ("Windows backend読込み", "msvcrtの直接importをimportlibと型Protocolへ変更。open・初期化・範囲は同じ"),
        "2d01543": ("workflow plan", "非同期利用箇所を追加。今回の同期flushの導入ではない"),
        "21decb6": ("履歴機能・複数process試験", "既存ロックを使う履歴保存と問題のテストを追加"),
        "40a93d1": ("待機延長・診断", "既にhistory-process timeoutを報告し、joinを15秒から60秒へ変更"),
        "afd7581": ("workflow plan・log", "追加資源・処理順序の変更。共通ロック本体に差分なし"),
        "1e5b47e": ("QS-001", "プラグインソース読込み変更。問題は以前の初回から再現"),
        "7835102": ("QS-002", "Referer変更。共通ロック本体に差分なし"),
        "aee66c9": ("QS-016", "秘密参照変更。共通ロック本体に差分なし"),
        "d7e6a1b": ("QS-013", "組立て失敗の解放変更。履歴workerの直接保存経路にcompose呼出しなし"),
        "98c0577": ("pytest依存", "opt-in Mailpitとpytest-mockの追加。共通ロック本体に差分なし"),
        "f6c336d": ("文字コード依存", "HTML文字コード用依存変更。共通ロック本体に差分なし"),
    }
    candidate_rows = []
    for record in inventory["commits"]:
        short = record["commit"][:7]
        if short in suspects:
            kind, reason = suspects[short]
            candidate_rows.append({"commit": record["commit"], "kind": kind, "reason": reason,
                                   "subject": record["metadata"].splitlines()[1],
                                   "changed_files": " | ".join(record["changed_files"]),
                                   "flush_reproduced": next(r["flush_errors"] > 0 for r in rows if r["commit"] == record["commit"])})
        classification[record["commit"]] = (suspects[short][0] if short in suspects else "その他変更・同じロック実装")
    integrations = []
    for record in results["integration"]:
        execution = record["execution"]
        summary = record["pytest_log"].strip().splitlines()[-1]
        integrations.append({"commit": record["commit"], "case": execution["label"], "seconds": execution["seconds"],
                             "exitcode": execution["exitcode"], "timed_out": execution["timed_out"],
                             "failure_kind": record["failure_kind"], "pytest_summary": summary})
    record = {"recorded_at": datetime.now().astimezone().isoformat(), "inventory": inventory,
              "runtime_results": results, "commit_summary": rows, "candidate_summary": candidate_rows,
              "incomplete_artifacts": incomplete_artifacts, "recheck_results": rechecks,
              "object_check": read(OUT / "object-check.json"),
              "origin_fetch_refspec": git("config", "--get-all", "remote.origin.fetch").strip(),
              "classifications": classification, "integration_summary": integrations,
              "totals": {"commits_checked_out": 52, "attempts": sum(r["attempts"] for r in rows),
                         "complete_commit_trials": sum(r["protocol_completed"] for r in rows),
                         "saved_attempts": sum(r["saved_attempts"] for r in rows),
                         "flush_errors": errors["initialization_flush_PermissionError"], "other_errors": errors["other"],
                         "commits_with_flush_error": sum(r["flush_errors"] > 0 for r in rows),
                         "integration_passed": sum(r["exitcode"] == 0 for r in integrations),
                         "integration_failed": sum(r["exitcode"] != 0 for r in integrations),
                         "recheck_attempts": sum(x["observation"]["attempts_requested"] for x in rechecks["observations"]),
                         "recheck_flush_errors": sum(x["observation"]["errors"].get("initialization_flush_PermissionError", 0)
                                                      for x in rechecks["observations"])},
              "root_preliminary_probe": read(OUT / "root-smoke/summary.json"),
              "source_and_original_uncommitted_changes_preserved": True,
              "source_probe": {"path": "probes/history_lock_revision_probe.py", "sha256": sha(DOCS / "probes/history_lock_revision_probe.py")},
              "driver_provenance": {name: {"sha256": sha(OUT / name), "source": (OUT / name).read_text(encoding="utf-8")}
                                    for name in ("inventory.py", "run_history.py", "environment.ps1", "collect_history.py", "recheck_incomplete.py")},
              "important_diffs": {
                  "initial_to_head_lock": git("diff", inventory["roots"][0], inventory["head"], "--", LOCK),
                  "history_test_wait": git("show", "40a93d1", "--", "tests/v3/application/test_workflow_history.py"),
                  "earliest_timeout_commit_message": git("show", "-s", "--format=fuller", "40a93d1")},
              "limits": ["Reachable branch/tag history after fetch; deleted refs and uncommitted pre-public history are unavailable",
                         "One root and no known good historical lock version; no first-good/first-bad transition established",
                         "Fresh Windows Python 3.11.4 runtime with current installed dependencies, not a reconstruction of each historical environment",
                         "Module probe excludes package initialization; original history integration tests additionally executed at six checkpoints",
                         "Open stop not reproduced in current COMODO-absent environment; zero lock hangs does not classify commits as historically good for open",
                         "One 30-round stress run per revision; one result collection failed and surviving worker counts are lower bounds",
                         "Separate rechecks of that revision are retained alongside the original incomplete case",
                         "Counts are correlated and scheduling-dependent",
                         "No full-v3 suite, historical CI matrix, or independent async stress executed for every revision",
                         "Earlier timeout report lacks native stack; it is not a confirmed instance of the current open stop"]}
    raw = DOCS / "raw/workflow-history-git-history-evidence-2026-10-11.json"
    raw.write_text(json.dumps(record, ensure_ascii=False, indent=2) + "\n", encoding="utf-8")
    for name, values in (("workflow-history-git-revisions-2026-10-11.csv", rows),
                         ("workflow-history-git-candidates-2026-10-11.csv", candidate_rows)):
        with (DOCS / name).open("w", encoding="utf-8-sig", newline="") as stream:
            writer = csv.DictWriter(stream, fieldnames=list(values[0]))
            writer.writeheader()
            writer.writerows(values)
    print(json.dumps(record["totals"], indent=2))
    print(json.dumps(integrations, indent=2))


if __name__ == "__main__":
    main()

import importlib.util
import json
from pathlib import Path

OUT = Path(__file__).resolve().parent
